notes.title: Patch Notes For May 10th
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where the player couldn't enter the boat game.
- Fixed some issues with wrong quests.

notes.title: Patch Notes For May 4th
notes.content:
- Fixed the bug, where the door to the castle wouldn't open
- Fixed a door in Birdcorp

notes.title: Patch Notes For May 1
notes.content:
- Fixed steam achievements that were not working
- Fixed various visual bugs

notes.title: Patch Notes 2 For April 27
notes.content:
- Fixed various visual bugs.
- Fixed an issue where some of the discovered flowers would not show in the inventory.

notes.title: Patch Notes For April 27
notes.content:
- Fixed a problem with the teleporter.
- You can now check a box when you load your game through the load save game menu to spawn the main character in the start area, if your save game is corrupt and spawns in the middle of nowhere.
- Fixed an issue with the windwall where the special cap would not be recognised.
- Fixed the problem where the player gets stuck after racing the bird in the start area.
- Fixed a lot of visual issues and added some QOL updates.

notes.title: Patch Notes For April 26
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue with the teleporter
- Fixed the respawn point for the smoke blocker
- Fixed an issue where the bar customers wouldn't talk after serving the wrong drink
- Fixed the umbrella icon and the wheel of luck
- Some of the steam achievements didn't work. They now do.

notes.title: Patch Notes 2 For April 25th
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue with the bee challenge, so that it doesn't trigger too early.
- Fixed various dialogues.
- Chests have an icon now and disappear in the inventory when used.
- Sheeps should not be stuck at the entrance any more.
- Fixed various issues with character dialogues where the player was stuck.

notes.title: Patch Notes for April 25th
notes.content:
- We fixed issues with some chests
- Improved the overall experience

notes.title: Update Notes 2 For April 24th
notes.content: We fixed small fixes with some characters

notes.title: Update Notes for 24th April
notes.content: Fixed issues in the quest guide.
